review_locator: PMCID:PMC2700822, Endoglycan vascular-selectin ligand study; PMCID:PMC1867022, Endothelial ligands for L-selectin
primary_title: Endoglycan, a member of the CD34 family, functions as an L-selectin ligand through modification with tyrosine sulfation and sialyl Lewis x; Low force decelerates L-selectin dissociation from P-selectin glycoprotein ligand-1 and endoglycan
decision_basis: The reviews identify endoglycan as a vascular L-selectin ligand and cite primary tyrosine-sulfation/glycoform and catch-bond studies showing direct L-selectin binding and rolling under flow.
limitations_preserved: Preserve endoglycan tyrosine sulfation, sialyl-Lewis X, Ca2+ and shear-threshold/catch-bond context; no endoglycan intracellular signaling or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2700822, Endoglycan vascular-selectin ligand study; PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review
primary_title: Endoglycan, a member of the CD34 family of sialomucins, is a ligand for the vascular selectins
decision_basis: The reviews identify endoglycan as a vascular-selectin ligand and the cited primary study shows immunopurified endoglycan binding P-selectin and recombinant endoglycan supporting sialic-acid/fucose-dependent rolling.
limitations_preserved: Preserve endoglycan sialylation/fucosylation and divalent-cation dependence, P-selectin flow context, and distinction from PSGL1; no intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC1867022, Endothelial ligands for L-selectin; PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review
primary_title: Binding of L-selectin to the vascular sialomucin CD34; Sialomucin CD34 is the major L-selectin ligand in human tonsil high endothelial venules
decision_basis: The reviews identify the HEV glycoform of CD34 as an L-selectin ligand and cite primary affinity and flow studies showing sulfated CD34-dependent lymphocyte tethering and rolling.
limitations_preserved: Preserve HEV-specific CD34 glycoform, sulfated O-glycan/MECA-79 context, PNAd multicomponent boundary, and lymphocyte-homing model; no CD34 intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2212365, Podocalyxin-like protein as an HEV ligand; PMCID:PMC1867022, Endothelial ligands for L-selectin
primary_title: Identification of podocalyxin-like protein as a high endothelial venule ligand for L-selectin: parallels to CD34
decision_basis: The reviews identify podocalyxin-like protein as a CD34-family L-selectin ligand and the cited primary study demonstrates purified HEV-derived PCLP binding recombinant L-selectin and supporting physiological lymphocyte rolling.
limitations_preserved: Preserve HEV-derived PCLP/PODXL glycoform, sulfated mucin-domain and flow context, and distinction from podocyte antiadhesive functions; no intracellular PODXL relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC1867022, Endothelial ligands for L-selectin; PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review
decision_basis: The reviews identify MAdCAM-1 as a facultative L-selectin ligand and the cited primary study shows tissue-derived MAdCAM-1 supports Ca2+/glycan-dependent L-selectin lymphocyte rolling under shear.
limitations_preserved: Preserve tissue-specific MAdCAM-1 glycosylation, facultative ligand status, α4β7 co-adhesion context, and lymphoid homing model; no MAdCAM1 intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review; PMCID:PMC7372927, Sialic acid roles for endothelial glycoproteins
primary_title: Sialomucin CD34 is the major L-selectin ligand in human tonsil high endothelial venules
decision_basis: The reviews cite the primary fractionation study showing appropriately glycosylated CD34 forms bind E-selectin and support rolling under flow.
limitations_preserved: Preserve E-selectin-active CD34 glycoforms, hematopoietic-cell and species boundaries, and distinction from CD44/HCELL; no CD34 intracellular relay or SCI inference.
